statement: P_CTC is inside EXP (PCTC ⊆ EXP), via a padded bounded-iteration machine for the register map

L-qg-119 follows from KnillParametrization (products of <=k two-qubit gates covered by countably many differentiable maps from R^(9k+3n+1), the KAK count). Proved unconditionally: a differentiable image of dimension < (card i)^2 is null for every left-invariant probability measure on U(i) (Cayley chart + Fubini + addHaar_image_eq_zero_of_differentiableOn_of_addHaar_eq_zero). Missing from Mathlib: the KAK (Cartan) decomposition of U(4).

L-qg-115 proved with C = 4: every radius-eps operator-norm ball in U(2^n) has Haar measure <= (4 eps)^(4^n), all eps >= 0. Fubini over the Cayley chart on K = {A : ||skewOf A||_op <= 1}: slices over A are balls (left invariance), slices over h lie in a translate of 4eps*K because the inverse chart is 2-Lipschitz on K ((1-X)(cX-cY)(1-Y) = 2(X-Y)). Standard axioms only. With C1's knill_of_ball this also gives L-qg-116 unconditionally.

reset_support_on_start_cycle: if a step map halts from every configuration and halting resets to start, every Deutsch-consistent distribution of the reset map is supported on the orbit of start (core of PSPACE in P_CTC); proved as stated
Reset-to-start trick behind PSPACE in P_CTC: if a step map halts from every configuration, every Deutsch-consistent state of the reset map is supported on the cycle through start.

Knill count for the continuous two-qubit gate set, rank 1a to 1c: operator norm of a gate matrix bounded by its entry sum, an entry-grid net of the two-qubit gates of size (n+1)^2 (C/delta)^32, and the approximate count of reachable unitaries.

L119 at 15k+1: if 15k+1 < 4^n then the products of at most k two-qubit gates are Haar-null (one global phase instead of one per gate). Cover lemma: every unitary is exp(i alpha) times a Cayley chart of a trace-zero skew matrix (spectral theorem plus an intermediate-value step on a sum of cotangents). Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.

PSPACE in P_CTC up to one named lemma: any language with a polynomial-time step encoding (init, step, halt test, answer; every register halts; first halt from start answers x in L) is in PCTC, via the Aaronson-Watrous reset circuit with an answer bit; hence PSPACE subset PCTC given PspaceStepEncodingLemma. Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.

Two-level saturation: every unitary of Fin d is a product of at most d(d+1)/2 unitaries that are the identity outside a 2x2 block (Givens column elimination plus d phases). Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.

Coffman-Kundu-Wootters monogamy for three qubits, full: for every (unnormalised) pure three-qubit state psi, C(rho_AB)^2 + C(rho_AC)^2 + 4|Det psi| = 4 det rho_A, hence tau_AB + tau_AC <= tau_A|BC, equality iff Cayley hyperdeterminant Det psi = 0. C is Wootters concurrence defined from the charpoly roots of rho * spin-flip(rho); reduced states are those of BeauvoirQG. Key lemma: rank-two rho = V V^H has C^2 = ||T||_F^2 - 2|det T|, T = V^T (sy x sy) V. Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.

PSPACE ⊆ PCTC (Aaronson-Watrous direction): every language of Library.PSPACE (Turing.FinTM2, UsesSpace) has a StepEncoding, by compiling the machine to the micro-instruction code, encoding configurations as bit strings padded by empty stacks, stepL = sstep (polynomial time), pc test, output-stack read-out, polynomial length bound from per-micro-step stack bounds, halting within 2^p steps by pigeonhole; with stepEncoding_of_timed this gives PspaceStepEncodingLemma and PSPACE_subset_PCTC. Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. P_CTC = PSPACE still needs PCTC ⊆ PSPACE.

Exact L-qg-119: if 9k+3n+1 < 4^n then the products of at most k two-qubit gates on n qubits are null for every left-invariant probability measure (Gap.L119), via KnillParametrization (countably many differentiable maps from R^(9k+3n+1) cover them). KAK for U(4) proved without Lie theory: every 4x4 unitary is (A1 tensor A2)(Qm diag Qd)(B1 tensor B2) in the magic basis Qm; the right factor of each gate is absorbed into a travelling layer of single-qubit gates. Standard axioms only.
